chunks: Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام said: When you raise your head from the second sajdah of the first rak'ah, at the time when you intend to stand, then sit upright evenly, then stand.

key_terms.ٱلسَّجْدَةِ ٱلثَّانِيَةِ: the second prostration in the rak'ah

ai.seo_question: How should one rise from the second sajdah to the next rak'ah in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a ruling on the manner of rising for the next rak'ah in salat (prayer). It instructs the worshipper to first settle into an upright sitting posture after the second sajdah of the first rak'ah, and then stand.
